errors.evidence: The x-axis range in the figure extends from 2^0 to 2^8, not 2^5.
For the Llama-3B model, the coverage at k=32 (which is 2^5 on the x-axis) is approximately 0.82, not 0.88.
For the Llama-3B + FT model, the coverage at k=32 (2^5) is approximately 0.83, not 0.88.
The Llama-1B model is represented by a line with circle markers, not diamond markers.
For the Llama-1B model, the starting coverage at k=1 is approximately 0.25, not 0.2. The value 0.2 is below the visible start of the y-axis range.
For the Llama-1B model, the coverage at k=32 (2^5) is approximately 0.72, not 0.82.
The Llama-1B + FT model is represented by a line with triangle markers, not cross markers.
For the Llama-1B + FT model, the starting coverage at k=1 is approximately 0.33, not 0.2.
For the Llama-1B + FT model, the coverage at k=32 (2^5) is approximately 0.73, not 0.84.
The description fails to mention the line styles (solid for base models, dotted for FT models), which is a key visual feature used to distinguish the series.
